text: When Ivan Ivanych visited his brother. <break time="0.8s" /> For the first time. <break time="0.8s" /> The place was hot and cheerless. <break time="0.8s" /> Crowded with fences, ditches. <break time="0.8s" /> And rows of young fir trees. <break time="0.8s" /> A fat reddish dog. <break time="0.8s" /> That looked rather like a pig. <break time="0.8s" /> Tried to bark. <break time="0.8s" /> But was too lazy. <break time="0.8s" /> And a barefoot cook. <break time="0.8s" /> Also fat and piglike. <break time="0.8s" /> Said her master was resting. <break time="0.8s" /> Nikolai himself lay in bed. <break time="0.8s" /> Grown stout and flabby. <break time="0.8s" /> With his cheeks, nose, and lips. <break time="0.8s" /> Pushed forward. <break time="0.8s" /> So that he seemed about to grunt. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the quilt. <break time="0.8s" /> Nikolai had changed completely. <break time="0.8s" /> For the shy, timid clerk of earlier years. <break time="0.8s" /> Now behaved like a grand gentleman. <break time="0.8s" /> And was deeply offended. <break time="0.8s" /> When the peasants failed to call him Your Honor. <break time="0.8s" /> He spoke solemnly. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a government minister. <break time="0.8s" /> About education and the common people. <break time="0.8s" /> Treated sick peasants with simple medicines. <break time="0.8s" /> And served them vodka on his name day. <break time="0.8s" /> Nikolai now spoke of himself proudly. <break time="0.8s" /> As a nobleman. <break time="0.8s" /> Even though their grandfather had been a peasant. <break time="0.8s" /> And their father a soldier. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had risen to the rank of officer. <break time="0.8s" /> That evening the cook brought in a plate of gooseberries. <break time="0.8s" /> The very first picked from the bushes. <break time="0.8s" /> And Nikolai looked at them in silence. <break time="0.8s" /> With tears in his eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he put one berry in his mouth. <break time="0.8s" /> And, with the triumph of a child. <break time="0.8s" /> Who has finally been given a long promised toy. <break time="0.8s" /> Exclaimed, How delicious. <break time="0.8s" /> Yet the gooseberries were hard and sour. <break time="0.8s" /> And Ivan Ivanych realized. <break time="0.8s" /> That his brother deceiving himself with a pleasant illusion. <break time="0.8s" /> Was happier than any truth could make him.
